The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the DBP ~
dividends to the National Government as provided for under Section 3 of Republic Act No. 7656 is
adjusted from at least fifty percent (50%) to ten percent (10%).

The adjusted dividend rate provided for under Section
1999 net earnings of the DBP.
is only applicable on

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately
